gloss: roadside; wayside; side of the road

definitions.gloss: roadside; wayside; edge of the road
definitions.explanation: The edge or side of a road or street, especially the strip just beside where people walk or drive.

examples.japanese: {道端|みちばた}に{花|はな}が{咲|さ}いている。
examples.english: Flowers are blooming by the roadside.

examples.japanese: {道端|みちばた}で{子猫|こねこ}を{拾|ひろ}った。
examples.english: I picked up a kitten on the side of the road.

examples.japanese: {道端|みちばた}に{座|すわ}り{込|こ}んで、しばらく{空|そら}を{見上|みあ}げていた。
examples.english: I sat down by the roadside and gazed up at the sky for a while.

notes:
{道端|みちばた} refers to the side or edge of a road. The {端|ばた} element (a voiced form of {端|はた}) means 'edge.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道端|みちばた}に: by the roadside (location)
- {道端|みちばた}で: at the roadside (where an action happens)
- {道端|みちばた}の{草|くさ}: roadside grass

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {路肩|ろかた}: road shoulder — the paved edge of a road for vehicles
- {歩道|ほどう}: sidewalk — a designated walkway
